Śigulā
father of Miṭṭaṇa Śukla (a. of Suślokaśataka, RORI. II. B. 5536. Extr. p.. 191-92).

Śigrupuṣparasāyanavidhi
med. Mysore N. D. XIII. 42843. Extr. p. 397. 42844. Extr. p.. 397-98.

Sigālavāda
or Sigolavādasutta or Siṅgālavādasutta or Śṛgālavādasūtra. 31st of the Dighanikāya of Suttapiṭaka. known a. Gihivinaya; deals with the moral conduct of the Buddhist layman.
Translated into English by late Prof. R. C. Childers from a collated copy of the Pāli text an. C. IA. Vol. XII. 1883, p. 23. For more ref. see Wint. HIL. Vol. II. p. 37.
Br. Mus. Pāli p.. 138-39 (3 mss.). Cambr. Uni. Pāli p. 146. Colombo D. I. 349. 351-52. Paris Pāli p. 32 (fr.). [Page053-a.
Pt.. (1). with Dighanikāya, Colombo, 1882. (2). Rangoon, 1895. (3). in Dharmakur Ser. Calcutta, 1913.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92, 92; 1892-1906, 697; 1906-28, 1051. 1460.
-C. Aṭṭakathā. Br. Mus. Pāli p.. 138-39 (3 mss.).

Siggamavāharāstotra
or Vighnaharaṇastotra. by Jinadatta Sūri. See under Vighnaharaṇastotra.

BORI. D. XVII. ii. 736 (in a collection). Jac. 696. RORI. II. A. 2219-20. III. A. 3188.
